neighbours.label: a person you go to and talk with about something (a good connection with your teachers, communicating with teachers, talk to a conductor, a doctor), as opposed to the same frames with things and to these people as subjects
fire: Build a good relationship with your teachers early on.
Here are some tips on talking with teachers about grades.
Speak to a conductor about changing your seat.
Talk to a doctor if the pain gets worse.
Be polite when you talk to your lecturer.
Ask your teacher for help after class.
Check with a pharmacist before you mix drugs.
Consult your lawyer before you sign.
quiet: Build a good fence around your garden early on.
Here are some tips on saving money on school shoes.
Sit on a bench while changing your shoes.
Take a nap if the pain gets worse.
Be careful when you park your car.
Ask your phone for the time after class.
The teachers went on strike in the spring.
The doctor was late for lunch on Monday.

short: a person you go to and talk with
notes: 'Talk to a friend' reached 0.18 in a probe, so the role may not matter much.
